{{Quote|You must be Han's buddy. You tell him this is it, my debt's paid off. I can't just hand these things out, you know?|Pall, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtP" />}}
'''Pall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he owed [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] a favor, which he paid off by giving a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] a customization kit that could change the color of a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].<ref name="SWG:TtP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pall appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Pall was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
